17679-the-story-of-a-nodding-donkey.title: Donkey
17679-the-story-of-a-nodding-donkey.creator: Laura Lee Hope
17679-the-story-of-a-nodding-donkey.description: A book by Laura Lee Hope. The Nodding Donkey dated his birth from the day he received the beautiful coat of varnish in the workshop of Santa Claus at the North Pole. Before that he was just some pieces of wood, glued together. His head was not glued on, however, but was fastened in such a manner that with the least motion the Donkey could nod it up and down, and also sidewise.

45135-the-thick-of-the-fray-at-zeebrugge.title: at Zeebrugge
45135-the-thick-of-the-fray-at-zeebrugge.creator: Percy F. Westerman
45135-the-thick-of-the-fray-at-zeebrugge.description: A book by Percy F. Westerman. "Wonder if she'll do it in time," thought Sub-lieutenant Alec Seton, R.N., as he stolidly paced the stone-paved platform. For the twentieth time in the last two hours he had consulted his wristlet watch and compared it with the smoke-begrimed station clock. "A proper lash-up if she doesn't."

arxiv-2112-06911.title: Projected Topological Branes
arxiv-2112-06911.creator: Archisman Panigrahi, Vladimir Juričić, Bitan Roy
arxiv-2112-06911.description: Abstract Abstract Nature harbors crystals of dimensionality ( d ) only up to three. Here we introduce the notion of projected topological branes (PTBs): Lower-dimensional branes embedded in higher-dimensional parent topological crystals, constructed via a geometric cut-and-project procedure on the Hilbert space of the parent lattice Hamiltonian.

arxiv-2112-15241.title: General Relativistic Shock Waves that Exhibit Cosmic Acceleration
arxiv-2112-15241.creator: Christopher E. Alexander
arxiv-2112-15241.description: Abstract This paper concerns the construction and analysis of a new family of exact general relativistic shock waves. The construction resolves the open problem of determining the expanding waves created behind a shock-wave explosion into a static isothermal sphere with an inverse square density and pressure profile.

arxiv-2301-08429.title: On the Uplink SINR Meta Distribution of UAV-assisted Wireless Networks
arxiv-2301-08429.creator: Yujie Qin, Mustafa A. Kishk, Member, IEEE, Mohamed-Slim Alouini, Fellow, IEEE
arxiv-2301-08429.description: Abstract This letter studies the signal-to-interference-plus-noise (SINR) meta distribution of uplink transmission of UAV-enabled wireless networks with inversion power control. Within a framework of stochastic geometry, the Matern cluster process (MCP) is used to model the locations of users and UAVs.

arxiv-2307-10400.title: Leveraging Plasmonic Hot Electrons to Quench Defect Emission in Metal - Semiconductor Nanostructured Hybrids: Experiment and Modeling
arxiv-2307-10400.creator: Kritika Sharu, Shashwata Chattopadhyay, K. N. Prajapati, J. Mitra
arxiv-2307-10400.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Kritika Sharu, Shashwata Chattopadhyay, K. N. Prajapati, J. Mitra. Modeling light-matter interaction in hybrid plasmonic materials is vital to their widening relevance from optoelectronics to photocatalysis. Here, we explore photoluminescence from ZnO nanorods (ZNR) embedded with gold nanoparticles (Au NPs). Progressive increase in Au NP concentration introduces significant structural disorder and defects in the ZNRs, which paradoxically quenches defect related visible photoluminescence (PL) while intensifying the near band edge (NBE) emission.

arxiv-2410-04020.title: “6 choose 4”: A framework to understand and facilitate discussion of strategies for overall survival safety monitoring
arxiv-2410-04020.creator: Godwin Yung
arxiv-2410-04020.description: Abstract Advances in anticancer therapies have contributed significantly to decreasing death rates in certain disease and clinical settings. However, they have also made it difficult to power a clinical trial in these settings with overall survival (OS) as the primary efficacy endpoint.

arxiv-2509-13805.title: Towards a Physics Foundation Model
arxiv-2509-13805.creator: Florian Wiesner, Matthias Wessling, Stephen Baek
arxiv-2509-13805.description: Abstract Foundation models have revolutionized natural language processing through a “ train once, deploy anywhere ” paradigm, where a single pre-trained model adapts to countless downstream tasks without retraining. Access to a Physics Foundation Model (PFM) would be transformative—democratizing access to high-fidelity simulations, accelerating scientific discovery, and eliminating the need for specialized solver development.

pmc-11527718.creator: Yazhou Guo, Yang Yuan, Ruibo Wang, Jun Bai, Yanqing Jia, Xinxin Qiu, Huafeng Niu, Long Li, Yan Luo, Baoyu Zhao, Zhencang Zhang
pmc-11527718.description: Monocrotaline (MCT), a major pyrrolizidine alkaloid, is well-known for its high liver toxicity. Dysregulation of autophagy induced apoptosis can lead to various liver diseases, including those induced by chemical compounds. Therefore, we aim to explore whether autophagy might serve as a potential strategy for addressing liver apoptosis caused by MCT.

pmc-12596559.title: HIV Pre-exposure Prophylaxis Does Not Increase Gonorrhea and Chlamydia Incidence in Young Black and Hispanic Men who Have Sex With Men: An Observational Cohort Study
pmc-12596559.creator: Octavio C Mesner, Rishabh Jain, Aditi Ramakrishnan, Derrick D Matthews, Jeremy T Goldbach
pmc-12596559.description: BackgroundHIV pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) use has been linked with increases in sexually transmitted infection (STI) incidence. Despite efforts to expand PrEP uptake among young Black and Hispanic men who have sex with men (YBHMSM), little research has been done to understand the impact of PrEP on STI incidence within these communities.

pmc-12634806.title: Promoting User Involvement to Foster Technological Citizenship in the Digitizing Healthcare Domain
pmc-12634806.creator: Anne Marte Gardenier, Iris Cramer, Rinie van Est
pmc-12634806.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) is playing an increasingly prominent role in healthcare technology, particularly in patient monitoring and diagnosis. While AI offers significant benefits, it raises concerns about the patient-provider relationship and key care values. To mitigate these risks and align technology with societal values, experts stress the importance of user involvement in technology development.

pmc-12663749.title: Hierarchical classification of anterior cruciate ligament using deep learning for athletes healthcare
pmc-12663749.creator: Xuejiao Yan, Lei Xiao
pmc-12663749.description: Introduction: Accurate and automated assessment of anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) injuries in MR images is essential for athlete healthcare and rapid diagnosis of knee injuries. However, challenges such as the small size of the ligament, variations in MR image quality, and complex anatomical structures complicate the classification process.

pmc-13117261.title: Radiation in Veterinary Practice: Paradigm Shift Toward Precision and Curative Approaches
pmc-13117261.creator: Sorin Marian Mârza, Camelia Munteanu, Radu Lăcătuş, Ionel Papuc, Florin Dumitru Bora, Robert Cristian Purdoiu
pmc-13117261.description: Ionizing radiation therapy has undergone a clear paradigm shift in veterinary oncology and inflammatory disease management, moving from mainly palliative use toward structured, curative treatment programs. This review synthesizes current evidence on key modalities used in veterinary practice, including external beam radiotherapy, brachytherapy, systemic targeted radionuclide therapy, stereotactic radiosurgery, stereotactic body radiotherapy, radiosynoviorthesis, and low-dose radiotherapy.

Daughters and mothers of these patients were also included, regardless of whether they were diagnosed with endometriosis or not.

pmc-13671026.title: Mammalian DNA methyltransferases in DNA methylation and imprinted gene expression in extraembryonic ectoderm of post-implantation embryos
pmc-13671026.creator: Ting Lu, Yilin Li, Yuping Wen, Zhen Xu, Haodong Lin, Guofeng Shao, Xiajun Li
pmc-13671026.description: DNA methylation in mammals is mainly catalyzed by three DNA methyltransferases (DNMTs). Conventionally, DNMT1 is considered the primary DNMT protein for maintenance DNA methylation, whereas DNMT3A and DNMT3B function in de novo DNA methylation. In two previous studies, we demonstrated that DNMT3A and DNMT3B maintain genome-wide DNA methylation in embryonic stem (ES) cells and in the epiblast of post-implantation embryos.
